problem: Constraints-facing part only: C10 makes every run document JSON with a schema and C11 puts freeze in the document. One fork is a constraint on who may write phase state, and a workflow script cannot write a file at all.

questions.text: Who writes a phase change and a gate approval into the launch record?
questions.why: No command a human types advances a run. Something still has to write the record; the options differ in whether an agent ever writes phase state.

options.value: The human writes gate approvals into the launch record (by editing it, or later through the control surface); a hook records each phase end when the workflow that ran the phase returns; no leaf sets phase or gate.
The orchestrator session writes phase and gates through a leaf after the human approves in chat.
The human writes both gates and phases; nothing automated touches the record.
